desc: Derive and prove a bounded-hop shortest-path characterization: show the exact possible forms of an optimal path and whether it needs at most two internal vertices.
Derive a structural characterization of connectivity in the disjoint-interval graph and identify how to test whether two vertices are connected.
Design coordinate prefix/suffix minimum preprocessing for intervals strictly left/right of given coordinates.
Formulate the exact minimum-cost expression for every valid optimal path pattern, preventing endpoints from being reused as internal vertices.
Validate the derived algorithm against touching, identical, nested, isolated, and nontrivial multi-intermediate cases.
Implement the final algorithm with `O(N + Q)` time and `O(N)` memory.
